title: GHG Emission Factors for Electricity Consumption
conversion_method: Numerically equal conversion because 1 t/MWh = 1 kg/kWh.
boundary: Life-cycle electricity factor including upstream supply-chain emissions.
evidence_type: Official published dataset; direct value from named country/year table cell.
applicability: National-average lifecycle grid factor. Not supplier-specific and the table time series ends in 2021.
uncertainty: Dataset point estimate. No probability distribution was supplied or inferred.
license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0), as stated on the JRC dataset landing page.
access_conditions: Public and anonymous download; no registration required.
method_publication: Bastos, J., Monforti-Ferrario, F. and Melica, G. (2024), JRC136340.
source_citation: Bastos, Joana; Monforti-Ferrario, Fabio; Melica, Giulia (2026): GHG Emission Factors for Electricity Consumption. European Commission, Joint Research Centre [Dataset]. DOI 10.2905/JRC.4800KC0.
provenance_note: The dataset landing page was retrieved and the XLSX table cell independently read; no interpolation or time extrapolation was applied.
